class Node:
    def __init__(self, val):
        self.val, self.next = val, None

def reverse_list(head):
    prev = None
    while head:
        nxt = head.next
        head.next = prev
        prev = head
        head = nxt
    return prev

head = Node(1)
cur = head
for v in [2, 3, 4, 5]:
    cur.next = Node(v)
    cur = cur.next
head = reverse_list(head)
out = []
while head:
    out.append(head.val)
    head = head.next
print(out)
